findings.description: wp-skills' verification gate is unpassable by wp-skills, because its residue grep covers a path wp-skills is explicitly denied. VERIFIED by running the gate's grep component verbatim: `git grep -lIi gemini -- skills scripts packages ':!*SKILL.md' ':!skills/langfuse/references' ':!skills/plan-feature/install_assets' ':!skills/plan-roadmap/templates' ':!skills/collect-transcripts/config.yaml.example'` returns 45 files, one of which is `skills/tests/agent-coordinator/test_kanban_viz_endpoints.py` (gemini at lines 995 and 1003: `("wp-db--gemini", "gemini")` and `"gemini": "gemini"`). But wp-skills `scope.deny` lists `skills/tests/agent-coordinator/**` (work-packages.yaml:212), and the only task that edits that file — 4.2 — was moved to wp-frontend by round-3 fix R3-C7. wp-frontend `depends_on: [wp-coordinator]`; wp-skills `depends_on: [wp-empirical]`. Neither depends on the other, so no scheduling order exists in which wp-skills' gate can go green: the file is either still gemini-bearing (gate fails) or was edited by a package wp-skills cannot wait on. Task 3.12's checkpoint carries the identical grep and the identical defect. This is a NEW defect introduced by the round-3 fix to finding 7 — the deny was added and the path was moved, but the gate's pathspec was never narrowed to match.
findings.resolution: Add `':!skills/tests/agent-coordinator'` to the wp-skills gate pathspec (work-packages.yaml:229) and to task 3.12's checkpoint grep (tasks.md:270). The path is then covered by wp-docs-finalize's full-suite gate, which runs `pytest skills/tests` after all three packages merge.

findings.description: Task 4.3's checkpoint contradicts both the wp-frontend gate and the `Historical vendor still renders` spec scenario — round-3 fix #4 was applied to work-packages.yaml but not to tasks.md. VERIFIED three ways. (a) tasks.md:296 says `git grep -lIi gemini -- apps/kanban-viz` must list "exactly the three provenance files"; task 4.1 (tasks.md:278-280) names those three as useCoordinator.ts, useCoordinator.test.tsx, coordinator-types.ts. (b) The wp-frontend gate (work-packages.yaml:292) diffs against an explicit FOUR-file set that additionally includes `apps/kanban-viz/src/__tests__/VendorSwimlanes.test.tsx`. (c) specs/coordinator-kanban-viz/spec.md:30-35 requires that file to keep a gemini fixture: "WHEN a card has a child agent whose agent_id suffix is `gemini` from a historical audit row THEN that agent SHALL render in its own lane labelled `gemini`" — and `grep -n -i gemini apps/kanban-viz/src/__tests__/VendorSwimlanes.test.tsx` shows the fixture at lines 22-23, 58, 62, 67, 72, 152. An implementer following checkpoint 4.3 literally would strip the gemini fixture to get down to three files, which simultaneously leaves the spec scenario untested and makes the wp-frontend gate's four-file diff fail. This is the exact class of contradiction round 3 killed, surviving in the sibling artifact.
findings.resolution: Rewrite tasks.md:296 to name the same four-file expected set as the gate, and state explicitly that VendorSwimlanes.test.tsx retains a gemini fixture to satisfy the `Historical vendor still renders` scenario.

findings.description: No gate anywhere — not in the plan, not in CI — executes the skill test directories that tasks 3.1, 3.4 and 3.8 write. VERIFIED by collection: `skills/.venv/bin/python -m pytest skills/tests --collect-only -q --ignore=skills/tests/agent-coordinator` collects 1249 tests and ZERO from `skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/tests`, `skills/collect-transcripts/tests`, or `skills/autopilot/scripts/tests` (grep -c over the collection output = 0). Every plan gate that runs skills tests uses exactly `pytest skills/tests` (wp-skills gate work-packages.yaml:229, task 3.12, wp-docs-finalize full-suite gate work-packages.yaml:382, task 6.2), and pytest does not recurse outside the path argument. CI does not close the hole either: `.github/workflows/ci.yml:40-64` job `test-infra-skills` runs `uv run pytest` from `skills/`, which uses `testpaths` in skills/pyproject.toml — that list contains `tests/parallel-infrastructure` but NOT `parallel-infrastructure/scripts/tests`, `collect-transcripts/tests`, or `autopilot/scripts/tests`; job `test-skills` (ci.yml:83) runs only `skills/bug-scrub/tests/ skills/fix-scrub/tests/`. `grep -rn 'collect-transcripts|parallel-infrastructure/scripts|autopilot/scripts/tests' .github/workflows/` returns nothing. Consequence: the wp-skills residue grep FORCES edits to six gemini-bearing files in those directories (test_consensus_synthesizer.py, test_integration_orchestrator.py, test_review_dispatcher.py, test_vendor_diversity.py is covered via skills/tests, test_implementation_strategy_selector.py, test_gemini_cli.py, fixtures/gemini_cli/) while never running them; and task 3.8's entire deliverable — three new transcript adapters plus their tests and fixtures under skills/collect-transcripts/ — lands on main with zero test execution in any gate or CI job.
findings.resolution: Extend the skills gate command in wp-skills, task 3.12, wp-docs-finalize and task 6.2 to `pytest skills/tests skills/parallel-infrastructure/scripts/tests skills/collect-transcripts/tests skills/autopilot/scripts/tests --rootdir=.` (or add those three paths to `testpaths` in skills/pyproject.toml as part of task 0.1, which already edits that file).

findings.description: wp-frontend's gate verifies neither of its two roster tasks; its residue component passes unchanged on the unmodified tree. VERIFIED: running the gate's diff component verbatim against the current tree — `diff <(git grep -lIi gemini -- apps/kanban-viz | sort) <(printf '%s\n' apps/kanban-viz/src/__tests__/VendorSwimlanes.test.tsx apps/kanban-viz/src/__tests__/useCoordinator.test.tsx apps/kanban-viz/src/hooks/useCoordinator.ts apps/kanban-viz/src/lib/coordinator-types.ts | sort)` — exits 0 with no output, because those four files are exactly what the tree has today. `git diff --quiet main... -- apps/kanban-viz/src/components/VendorSwimlanes.tsx` also exits 0 today (correctly so — it is an invariant pin, not a progress check). That leaves `npm test -- --run` as the only live component, and task 4.1 changes fixture data and its assertions together, so the suite passes identically before and after the roster swap. Separately, wp-frontend also owns task 4.2 (`skills/tests/agent-coordinator/test_kanban_viz_endpoints.py`, moved here by round-3 fix R3-C7) but its gate neither greps nor executes that path at all. Net: wp-frontend can be reported complete with tasks 4.1 and 4.2 entirely unperformed. Note this is a narrower claim than round 3's finding #4 — the four-file expected set is the CORRECT set (see finding 2); it is simply not a progress signal.
findings.resolution: Add a positive assertion to the wp-frontend gate that the new roster actually appears — e.g. `git grep -q 'wp-[a-z]*--grok' -- apps/kanban-viz/src/__tests__/VendorSwimlanes.test.tsx` — and add `skills/.venv/bin/python -m pytest skills/tests/agent-coordinator -q` plus a `grok`/`antigravity`/`pi` presence check for task 4.2.

findings.description: Round-3 fixes #3 and #9 added tasks and write-scopes but no verification, so both new tasks are ungated. VERIFIED: `git grep -lIi gemini -- docs/cross-repo-setup.md openspec/schemas/feature-workflow/templates/session-log.md skills/plan-feature/install_assets/openspec/schemas/feature-workflow/templates/session-log.md` returns all three files today, yet none of the three appears in wp-docs-finalize's residue file list (work-packages.yaml:374), which enumerates 21 paths explicitly and stops at `skills/collect-transcripts/SKILL.md`. They are also not reachable by any other gate: the wp-skills grep excludes `skills/plan-feature/install_assets`, the wp-coordinator grep is scoped to `agent-coordinator`, and the mirror-residue check passes `--exclude-dir=templates --exclude-dir=install_assets` (and neither `openspec/schemas/` nor `docs/` is under `.claude/skills`/`.agents/skills` anyway). So tasks 5.3's `docs/cross-repo-setup.md` edit and all of task 5.5a can be skipped and every gate still goes green — the same silent-skip condition that motivated adding them.
findings.resolution: Append `docs/cross-repo-setup.md openspec/schemas/feature-workflow/templates/session-log.md skills/plan-feature/install_assets/openspec/schemas/feature-workflow/templates/session-log.md` to the wp-docs-finalize residue grep pathspec at work-packages.yaml:374 and to task 5.7's checkpoint.

findings.description: Round-3 fix #10 (R3-C10) is incomplete within the very paragraph it repaired: the operator live-billing authorization still names the wrong phase. VERIFIED by reading design.md:376-379: "live dispatch against `agy`, `grok`, and `pi` is approved. **Tasks 1.1-1.3** may invoke these CLIs with real prompts ... No further approval is required for the **Phase 2** verification calls." The first sentence was renumbered correctly. The second was not: Phase 2 in tasks.md:116-189 is Coordinator config (2.1-2.10) and makes no CLI calls at all, while the actual billed live dispatch is task 6.3 in Phase 6 (tasks.md:378-381). wp-docs-finalize's manual gate (work-packages.yaml:390-393) rests its authorization on exactly this record: "Operator authorization for billed calls is on record in design.md." So the manual reviewer of task 6.3 is pointed at an authorization that, read literally, covers a phase making no calls and does not cover theirs. This is the same defect R3-C10 identified (billing authority attached to the wrong task numbers) surviving one sentence deeper — a revision-1 phase number where revision-1's Phase 2 was the smoke phase.
findings.resolution: Change design.md:378-379 to "No further approval is required for the task 6.3 live smoke dispatch (Phase 6)." Then re-scan design.md for any remaining bare phase numbers in live sections, not only task numbers.

findings.description: Task 5.6 does not name a target file, but its gate constrains one. VERIFIED: tasks.md:353-354 says only "Document the optional `~/.grok/config.toml` `[skills] paths` setup as operator-level, citing https://docs.x.ai/build/features/skills-plugins-marketplaces", while wp-docs-finalize's gate (work-packages.yaml:374) runs `git grep -q 'docs.x.ai/build/features/skills-plugins-marketplaces' -- docs/`, which restricts the citation to the `docs/` tree. `git grep -c` for that URL under `docs/` returns nothing today, so the gate is at least non-vacuous — but an implementer who reasonably places the operator note in `README.md` or `skills/setup-coordinator/SKILL.md` (both in wp-docs-finalize's write_allow) fails a gate the task never told them about.
findings.resolution: Name the target file in task 5.6 — `docs/cross-repo-setup.md` is the natural home given task 5.3 already opens it in the same package.
